purpose: Generate a molecule-selection research program — NOT pretend the molecule exists. Per CEO R278 directive: 'The machine should generate a molecule-selection research program, not pretend the molecule exists.'
constitutional_basis: Article XXV — unknown must remain unknown. Article XXXIV — chemistry is the next bottleneck, not code.

step_1_candidate_molecular_mechanisms.output: Structured list of candidate molecule CLASSES with pressure-responsive properties

candidates.mechanism: Molecular rotation rate changes with viscosity/pressure, modulating fluorescence quantum yield
candidates.examples: DCVJ, julolidine derivatives, BODIPY molecular rotors
candidates.key_advantage: Direct optical readout — no aptamer or electrochemical sensor needed
candidates.key_disadvantage: Sensitivity may be too low for ICP range (kPa, not MPa)

candidates.mechanism: Mechanical strain cleaves a covalent bond, releasing a small molecule
candidates.pressure_sensitivity_estimate: Threshold-based (not proportional) — releases only above threshold strain
candidates.detection_method: Released small molecule detected by wearable sensor
candidates.key_advantage: Direct pressure-to-molecule transduction (no electronics in brain)
candidates.key_disadvantage: Most mechanophores require MPa strain, not kPa. ICP range is 0-50 mmHg = 0-7 kPa. May be 100x too low.
candidates.status: HIGH RISK — requires novel mechanophore design with kPa threshold

candidates.mechanism: Lipid bilayer permeability changes with pressure, releasing encapsulated contents
candidates.examples: Pegylated DSPC/cholesterol liposomes with tunable transition temperature
candidates.pressure_sensitivity_estimate: Threshold-based but potentially tunable to ICP range
candidates.detection_method: Encapsulated fluorescent dye or electroactive molecule detected externally
candidates.key_advantage: Biocompatible. Tunable. Existing pharmaceutical manufacturing infrastructure.
candidates.key_disadvantage: Threshold behavior (not proportional). Hysteresis. Chronic stability unknown.
candidates.status: CANDIDATE — requires feasibility screen to assess proportional release

candidates.mechanism: Piezoelectric material deforms under pressure, mechanically expelling molecule from reservoir
candidates.examples: PZT or PVDF piezoelectric membrane with drug reservoir
candidates.pressure_sensitivity_estimate: Potentially proportional (piezoelectric response is linear in pressure)
candidates.detection_method: Released molecule detected by wearable sensor
candidates.key_advantage: Proportional response. Established physics. No chemistry breakthrough needed.
candidates.key_disadvantage: Contains a PIEZOELECTRIC MATERIAL — this is arguably 'electronics in brain', which contradicts P-09's zero-electronics premise. May undermine the core value proposition.
candidates.status: PHILOSOPHICAL CONFLICT — may not satisfy 'zero electronics' claim

candidates.mechanism: Solid-liquid phase transition temperature shifts with pressure, modulating release rate
candidates.pressure_sensitivity_estimate: Clapeyron slope: ~0.01-0.1 °C/mmHg. At 37°C, a 1°C shift = 10-100 mmHg. Potentially usable.
candidates.detection_method: Released molecule (dye or marker) detected by wearable sensor
candidates.key_advantage: Pure physics/chemistry — no electronics. Tunable by chain length.
candidates.key_disadvantage: Hysteresis between melting and solidification. Not proportional (threshold behavior at phase transition). Chronic stability unknown.
candidates.status: CANDIDATE — requires feasibility screen to assess hysteresis and proportionality

step_2_feasibility_screen.method: Computational chemistry (DFT, MD simulations) + literature deep-dive on each candidate
questions_per_candidate: Can the pressure sensitivity reach 0.1%/mmHg across the 5-40 mmHg range?
Is the response proportional (linear) or threshold-based?
Has anyone demonstrated this class in a physiological pressure range (kPa, not MPa)?
step_2_feasibility_screen.go_no_go_gate: At least ONE candidate class must have computational evidence of proportional response in the kPa range with < 10% hysteresis. If none, P-09 is DEAD.
step_2_feasibility_screen.output: Feasibility matrix. Top 2-3 candidate classes advance to Step 3.

step_3_transport_model.method: In silico CSF flow simulation + diffusion modeling
questions: Does the candidate molecule reach a wearable-detectable site (lumbar subcutaneous, scalp) within 10-180 minutes?
What is the attenuation factor (concentration at detection site vs concentration at release site)?
How does patient-specific ventricular anatomy affect transport time?

simulation_setup.anatomy: Anatomically accurate ventricular + spinal canal geometry from ITK-SNAP segmentation atlas
simulation_setup.flow_model: Navier-Stokes with pulsatile boundary conditions (cardiac-driven CSF oscillation)
simulation_setup.diffusion_model: Stokes-Einstein with CSF viscosity 1.0 cP, temperature 37°C
simulation_setup.patient_cohort: 10 virtual patients with varying ventricular size, spinal canal length, body habitus

step_3_transport_model.go_no_go_gate: At least ONE candidate must reach detectable concentration (>= 10 nM) at a wearable site within 180 minutes in >= 8/10 virtual patients.
step_3_transport_model.output: Transport feasibility assessment per candidate. Top 1-2 candidates advance.

step_4_detectability_assessment.method: Sensor technology assessment + bench-top detection limit measurement
questions: Can an electrochemical aptamer sensor detect the candidate at 10 nM in synthetic interstitial fluid?
Can an optical fluorescence sensor detect it through skin?
What is the sensor's selectivity against common interferents?
What is the sensor's drift over 7 days?
sensor_candidates: Electrochemical aptamer (requires 6-12 month aptamer development per molecule)
Optical fluorescence (requires molecule to be fluorescent, or labeled with fluorophore)
step_4_detectability_assessment.go_no_go_gate: At least ONE sensor technology must demonstrate 10 nM detection limit with > 100x selectivity in synthetic interstitial fluid.
step_4_detectability_assessment.output: Sensor-molecule pairing. 1 candidate molecule + 1 sensor technology advances.

step_5_safety_constraints.method: Literature review + computational toxicity prediction (QSAR, Derek Nexus)
questions: What is the known toxicity profile of the candidate molecule?
What is the maximum safe chronic CSF concentration?
Does the molecule have any known immunogenicity?
Are there any structural alerts (mutagenicity, carcinogenicity)?
step_5_safety_constraints.go_no_go_gate: Candidate must have no structural alerts for mutagenicity/carcinogenicity. Maximum safe chronic concentration must be >= 100x the detection limit (safety margin).
step_5_safety_constraints.output: Safety profile. If GO, candidate advances to experimental plan.

step_6_shortlist_and_experimental_plan.method: Integrate results from Steps 1-5. If any candidate survived all gates, write the experimental plan.
step_6_shortlist_and_experimental_plan.output_if_GO: Specific molecule identity + synthesis route + transducer design + sensor specification + in vitro test protocol + in vivo (animal) test protocol
step_6_shortlist_and_experimental_plan.output_if_NO_GO: P-09 is DEAD. The architecture is novel but no viable molecule exists with current technology. Record in cemetery. The finding 'chemical molecular ICP signaling is not currently feasible' is itself a valuable negative result.

experimental_plan_if_GO.phase_a_synthesis: 3-6 months. Synthesize the molecule. Confirm structure by NMR/MS.
experimental_plan_if_GO.phase_b_bench_test: 3-6 months. Build pressure chamber. Measure pressure-to-release curve. Confirm 0.1%/mmHg sensitivity, < 10% hysteresis.
experimental_plan_if_GO.phase_c_csf_stability: 6 months. 180-day in vitro stability test in synthetic CSF at 37°C.
experimental_plan_if_GO.phase_d_sensor_integration: 3-6 months. Build wearable sensor. Measure detection limit, selectivity, drift.
experimental_plan_if_GO.phase_e_animal_model: 12-24 months. Implant in animal model. Measure ICP-to-concentration-to-sensor end-to-end transfer function.
experimental_plan_if_GO.total_if_GO: Additional 24-48 months after Step 6. Total from now: 36-60 months to know if P-09 is clinically viable.

program_summary.honest_disclosure: This program may conclude that NO viable molecule exists with current technology. That is a valid outcome. If so, the architecture concept dies — but the finding 'chemical molecular ICP signaling is not currently feasible' is itself a contribution to the field.
program_summary.what_we_do_NOT_do: We do NOT pretend the molecule exists. We do NOT build TTPs around an unspecified molecule. We do NOT claim P-09 is prototype-ready. We generate the research program and let the chemistry answer the question.

collaborator_requirements.step_3: CFD engineer with anatomical flow modeling experience
collaborator_requirements.step_6: Program lead (the package owner) + all of above
collaborator_requirements.ideal_collaborator: A medicinal chemistry program at a research university or contract research organization. Examples: Broad Institute, Scripps Research, UCSF School of Pharmacy, WuXi AppTec (CRO).
